Great Vietnamese food- decent price in the most expensive Saigon mall
Jan 2018 • Couples
I was at Saigon Center this week, looking to try good Vietnamese food in the area. And Ngo is the right choice. They have a good range of Viet menu from street food cha gio (spring rolls), bun thit nuong (grilled pork chop with rice vermicelli salad), goi cuon (shrimp rolls), appetizers, to a delicious pho noodle soup (see photo), banh xeo (Vietnamese pancake) popular drinks, sweet, desserts. Very good price in my opionon from 55 -80 thousand Vnd/dish as this location is expected to be premium pricey.

The menu layout is catching to me. With photos I can see what I wanted to try, so easy for my selection. Food portion is just right. You don't need too much as there are so many delicious food to try right :) 

You will like it and feel satisfied. For sure!
